plan.acceptance: Require complete identical acquisition coverage and unchanged component geometry, identity, pose and motion. Confirmed-alarm frames, alarm episodes and unknown frames must not increase for full corpus or either predeclared partition. No default promotion solely from an empty-corpus pass.
plan.temporal_protocol: One uninterrupted detector per variant; no reset at database or development/evaluation boundaries. Metrics sliced by original record timestamps. Partition episodes restart at partition boundaries and are not additive.

validity: Organizer statement relayed directly by project owner: first real recording contains one person, remaining supplied real tunnels contain no obstacles. Synthetic organizer bag is separate. This is not exhaustive per-point human annotation.

Contiguous full-recording segments 0..139 development and 140..220 frozen evaluation. Segment200 and several other intervals were already inspected; no blind holdout claim. Do not use evaluation background for synthetic tuning.
One detector instance across all segments. Evaluation partition inherits preceding track state; not an independent cold start.
Partition episode counts restart at partition boundaries; do not sum them as full-recording episode counts.
Duration uses left-held observed state between acquisitions; no extension past the last acquisition or across gaps above 0.5s.
Missing time is excluded, not clear-route evidence. Operational episodes are not independent physical obstacles.
Negative-corpus gate cannot establish obstacle recall or field safety; no threshold tuning performed on evaluation results.
